findings.title: Possible hardcoded secret
findings.description: A secret-like name has a literal value. Determine whether it is an active credential or a harmless fixture. Suspected indicator; manual review required. No data-flow analysis was performed.
findings.remediation: Remove active credentials from source, rotate any exposed value, and load secrets from an appropriate environment or secret store.
reproduction_steps: Review insecure.js at line 2 without executing the source.
Trace data origin and usage manually; determine exploitability in the application's context.
